CVE-2026-137974.description: A flaw was found in tuned. This vulnerability allows local privilege escalation because the spindown-disk profile script does not properly validate filesystem mount sources before executing remount operations with root privileges. A local user capable of creating user-space filesystems can craft a malicious mount entry to execute arbitrary commands as root.
